Working in Windermere

What tends to matter here.

Lakefront properties

Many Windermere homes sit on the Butler Chain of Lakes, where drainage and runoff deserve careful planning.

Large lots

Bigger properties mean bigger lawns, longer hedge lines and longer driveways.

Design and upkeep

A landscape built and kept by the same company.

Questions

Before you call.

Do you serve Windermere?

Windermere is in our extended service area. Send the form or call 407-717-8191 and we will confirm whether we can schedule your address before booking a visit.

Is the estimate free?

Yes. Estimates are free. The only published fee is digital landscape design work: as of 7/1/2023 it is $250, with a 50% deposit, and the $250 is credited toward the landscape project if the package is approved.

Can you do landscaping and washing on the same property?

Yes. Both halves are handled by one company, so they can be scoped and scheduled together.
